rationale: The assistant declined a plainly in-scope washer-dryer fault after a single message, offering no questions, no power-reset or RCD/socket checks, no warranty prompt and no model request, despite the customer already supplying useful evidence (dead after power cut, plug fuse swapped). It invented nothing and gave a generic safe stop-use caveat plus a vague pointer to an engineer, so it was harmless, but it ignored what the customer said and made zero diagnostic progress. A UK homeowner would be left with nothing actionable beyond 'call someone'.
